name: rawmarkets
description: RawMarkets - Microsoft Windows AI markets terminal built with Vite, React, TypeScript, Electron, Node, Playwright scrapers, SQLite, and local AI for metals, energy, equities, portfolio research, and news signals.

scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:better-sqlite3 --external:playwright --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && node scripts/copy-migrations.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run build:ftp && npm run package:win:artifacts
scripts.package:portable-memory: npm run build && node scripts/electron-package.mjs portable-memory
scripts.package:nsis-clean: npm run build && node scripts/electron-package.mjs nsis-clean
scripts.package:win:artifacts: npm run package:portable-memory:only && npm run package:nsis-clean:only
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run package:win:artifacts
scripts.test:research: tsx --test tests/portfolioFactors.test.ts tests/portfolioForecast.test.ts tests/migrations.test.ts tests/portfolioResearchJob.test.ts tests/ollamaExtract.test.ts tests/ollamaChat.test.ts tests/localAiContext.test.ts tests/wealthBibleRuleSpace.test.ts tests/newsArticleStore.test.ts tests/localAiTools.test.ts tests/localAiAgent.test.ts tests/localAiNewsResolve.test.ts tests/localAiWebIntent.test.ts tests/serpNewsSearch.test.ts tests/assetLifecycle.test.ts tests/catalogRemovals.test.ts tests/dashboardLayout.test.ts tests/symbolLogo.test.ts tests/newsBayRank.test.ts tests/newsSentiment.test.ts
